body.name: Automated backups enabled
body.description: Critical data is backed up automatically.
body.detail: Backups are the responsibility of the platform this is deployed on.
observations: State lives in two places only — Postgres (system of record) and Neo4j (derived graph) — which makes the backup scope small and clear.
Neo4j is fully rebuildable from Postgres by re-running the graph build, so the irreplaceable backup target is Postgres alone.
